note: Largest campground at Calamus Reservoir SRA, 6 mi NW of Burwell in the Sandhills: paved, level 50-amp back-in sites with mature shade; shower house, modern restrooms, water; dump station and laundry in the park. The white-sand swimming beach and boat ramp are a separate day-use area to the southwest. Some sites reservable up to 180 days out, the rest FCFS. Park entry permit required. --Claude
